column1: #@source motanka-stack-shell
#@packages motanka-stack-shell
# Upstream components of motanka-stack-shell: Quickshell, the desktop shell
# of upstream Omarchy v4.5.0, and cpptrace, which its crash handler needs;
# omasnap, Upstream's screenshot tool, and layer-shell-qt, which it needs;
# ttfx, the text effects program of Upstream's screensaver;
# hyprland-preview-share-picker, the screen share picker of Upstream's
# xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland configuration (26.04 only).
# Same format as stack/components.tsv (see the comment there). Built by
# packaging/motanka-stack-shell/debian/shell-build.sh in file order, for
# the suites each line names, against the Stack's Qt 6.12 (motanka-qt6) on
# both. Every component's tarball (and the crates of every cargo
# component) is in the source package for both suites; a component whose
# suites do not include the build's suite is unpacked but not built.
#   wayland            noble only, build time only, the Stack's version
#                      (1.24.0, same tarball and checksum as
#                      stack/components.tsv). Qt 6.12's generated private
#                      header QtWaylandClient/private/wayland-wayland-client-
#                      protocol.h uses the include guard of the system's
#                      wayland-client-protocol.h, so noble's 1.22 header,
#                      included first, hides wl_fixes and Quickshell fails to
#                      compile. The staged 1.24 headers come first instead;
#                      at run time Quickshell loads the Stack's libwayland
#                      from motanka-stack-libs.
#   wayland-protocols  build time only, the Stack's version (1.50, same
#                      tarball and checksum as stack/components.tsv), so
#                      Quickshell sees the same protocols as Hyprland on
#                      both releases. omasnap takes its ext-image-capture-
#                      source and ext-image-copy-capture XML from here too:
#                      noble's archive (1.34) has neither.
#   libdwarf-lite      build "source": not built on its own. cpptrace's
#                      CMake fetches it from git at configure time, which
#                      the network-less sbuild chroot cannot do, so the
#                      build points FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_LIBDWARF at this
#                      folder. The version must be the one cpptrace pins as
#                      CPPTRACE_LIBDWARF_TAG; shell-build.sh fails when
#                      cpptrace names a different version.
#   cpptrace           shared, with libunwind (Quickshell's crash handler
#                      refuses it otherwise); libcpptrace ships in
#                      motanka-stack-shell.
#   quickshell         the GitHub mirror's tag; no git submodules.
#   cmake              noble only, build time only, the Stack's CMake
#                      (4.5.0, same tarball and checksum as
#                      stack/components.tsv), built with noble's CMake 3.28
#                      into debian/shell-build/tools. extra-cmake-modules
#                      needs CMake 3.30. Only extra-cmake-modules,
#                      layer-shell-qt and omasnap are configured with it;
#                      cpptrace and Quickshell keep the archive's CMake.
#                      resolute's own CMake is new enough.
#   extra-cmake-modules  KDE's CMake modules (ECM), build time only:
#                      layer-shell-qt needs ECM 6.30 or later.
#   layer-shell-qt     KDE's Qt client library for wlr-layer-shell, built
#                      against motanka-qt6: the archive's layer-shell-qt
#                      uses Qt's private API of the archive's Qt (6.4 or
#                      6.10) and cannot load with Qt 6.12. Ships
#                      libLayerShellQtInterface, the Qt Wayland shell
#                      integration plugin and the org.kde.layershell QML
#                      module, all under /opt/motanka/lib.
#   omasnap            Upstream's screenshot and annotation tool
#                      (omacom/omasnap); Upstream's
#                      bin/omarchy-capture-screenshot runs it. Its CMake
#                      file names /usr/share/wayland-protocols; the patch
#                      debian/patches/omasnap-wayland-protocols-dir.patch
#                      makes that folder a cache variable, which the build
#                      points at the staged wayland-protocols.
#   ttfx               Upstream's Rust port of terminaltexteffects
#                      (omacom/ttfx); Upstream's bin/omarchy-screensaver
#                      runs it in a loop and polls for it, so without it
#                      the idle screensaver spins and cannot be dismissed.
#                      Build "cargo": stack/fetch-sources reads the
#                      tarball's Cargo.lock, downloads every crates.io
#                      crate it lists, checks each against the lock file's
#                      SHA-256 and packs them into the extra component
#                      ttfx-crates (orig-ttfx-crates.tar.gz, no pin of its
#                      own: Cargo.lock is inside the pinned tarball). The
#                      build compiles offline with the archive's cargo-1.91
#                      and rustc-1.91 against that folder. ttfx loads only
#                      libc and libgcc_s from the host, so it has no
#                      RUNPATH.
#   hyprland-protocols  resolute only, build "source": not built on its
#                      own, the Stack's version (0.8.0, same tarball and
#                      checksum as stack/components.tsv). The share
#                      picker's source has an empty git-submodule folder
#                      lib/hyprland-protocols; the build replaces it with a
#                      symbolic link to this folder. The only file it reads
#                      is protocols/hyprland-toplevel-export-v1.xml, which
#                      is byte-identical in 0.8.0 and in the submodule
#                      commit 3a5c2bda that Upstream's PKGBUILD uses.
#   hyprland-preview-share-picker  resolute only. Upstream's
#                      config/hypr/xdph.conf names it as the
#                      custom_picker_binary of xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland,
#                      and xdph 1.5.0 fails every screen share when that
#                      picker cannot start. The Stack builds xdph for 26.04
#                      only, and 24.04 has no gtk4-layer-shell, so 24.04
#                      gets neither. The commit and version are those of
#                      Upstream's PKGBUILD (omacom/omarchy-pkgs): v0.3.0
#                      plus WhySoBad/hyprland-preview-share-picker#30 (shm
#                      pool sizing). Build "cargo", as ttfx, against the
#                      archive's GTK 4 and gtk4-layer-shell; the crates are
#                      the component hyprland-preview-share-picker-crates.
#                      The patch debian/patches/
#                      hyprland-preview-share-picker-build-rs.patch
#                      replaces build.rs, which asks git for the version
#                      (and panics without a repository), with the
#                      PKGBUILD's one-line version
#                      "v0.3.0-r3-g07602ef". The build also writes the
#                      program's config schema ("schema" subcommand) to
#                      /opt/motanka/share/hyprland-preview-share-picker/
#                      schema.json, as the PKGBUILD does. It loads only
#                      host libraries, so it has no RUNPATH.
# Download, verify and pin: stack/fetch-sources --components stack/shell-components.tsv
# name
wayland
wayland-protocols
